# Ranking

`search_offers` ranks offers by the `sort` argument: `cheapest`, `fastest` or `best_value`. Comps, diagnostics and offers with `delivery: no` are not ranked.

In every sort, an offer whose `moq` is larger than `qty` goes to the end of the list.

## cheapest

Sorts by `landed_aud`, lowest first. Between two offers with the same cost, one with a known delivery status comes before one with `unknown`.

A grocery offer sorts by `unit_price_aud`. A 2 L bottle at 4.50 AUD (2.25 per litre) then comes before a 1 L bottle at 3.10 AUD.

An offer with no price goes last.

## fastest

Sorts by the later bound of `shipping.eta_days`, then by `price_aud`. An offer with no ETA counts as 99 days.

The ETA windows are fixed per marketplace. [Delivery and ETA](../reference/marketplaces.md#delivery-and-eta) lists them.

## best_value

Sorts by a score from 0 to 1, highest first:

**best_value score**

```text
score = 0.5 * price + 0.25 * speed + 0.25 * trust
score = score - 0.05   when delivery is unknown
```

| Part | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `price` | `1 - min(1, unit cost / 200)`. Unit cost is `landed_aud / qty`, or `price_aud` when there is no landed cost. An offer with neither counts as 50 AUD. |
| `speed` | `1 - min(1, latest ETA day / 30)`. An offer with no ETA counts as 14 days. |
| `trust` | The first of the four rules below that applies. |

| Trust rule | Value |
| --- | --- |
| The offer has deal-site votes | `0.5 + net votes / 20`, held between 0 and 1 |
| The seller has a rating | `rating / 5` |
| `source_reliability` is `authoritative` | 0.85 |
| `source_reliability` is `aggregator` | 0.7 |
| None of these | 0.5 |

An item that costs 200 AUD or more per unit scores 0 for price. Above that cost, only speed and trust separate offers.

## Currency

`price_cny` converts with `CNY_TO_AUD` (default 0.215) and Cheapies prices with `NZD_TO_AUD` (default 0.92). Both are fixed settings. The server fetches no live rates.
